description: The main window reaches the core only through the shim (core_fetch, core_cancel, core_upload), which holds the secret and lets through only the core's own routes, and asks the shell where the core's log is and whether it has started. It may ask whether a signed update is out and install it on the engineer's say-so (update_check, update_install); the updater plugin's own commands are not allowed. It may open the folder picker (screens ask for folders only; the dialog plugin cannot narrow that further) and save an export the engineer chose to save (save_export opens the native Save dialog itself). No shell, opener or file-system plugin: the page opens no outside link and reads no path itself.
